moments.title: Premier League Kicks Off
moments.blurb: The 2026/27 Premier League season begins this Friday, August 21st, with defending champions Arsenal hosting newly-promoted Coventry City.

angles.name: Opening Match Buzz
angles.copy: It's back! The Premier League season kicks off tomorrow night with Arsenal facing Coventry. Who's ready for the drama?

angles.name: Weekend Fixtures
angles.copy: Beyond the Friday opener, Man Utd, Liverpool, Man City, Chelsea and Spurs all play their first Premier League games this weekend. Predictions?

angles.name: Coventry's Return
angles.copy: Coventry City are back in the top flight after 25 years! Big test against Arsenal for their Premier League return.

moments.title: Reading & Leeds Festival
moments.blurb: The twin Reading and Leeds Festivals run from Thursday, August 27th to Sunday, August 30th, across Richfield Avenue and Bramham Park, featuring a diverse lineup.

angles.name: Festival Countdown
angles.copy: Just one week until Reading & Leeds Festival takes over the August Bank Holiday weekend! Who's heading to Richfield Avenue or Bramham Park?

angles.name: Last Minute Prep
angles.copy: Tents, wellies, and glitter at the ready! Reading & Leeds is almost here. What's your festival essential?

angles.name: Lineup Excitement
angles.copy: From rock to pop to dance, Reading & Leeds promises something for everyone. Which acts are you most hyped to see?

moments.title: We Out Here Festival Underway
moments.blurb: We Out Here Festival, curated by Gilles Peterson, is currently running in Wimborne St Giles, Dorset, until August 23rd, celebrating world-class music and culture. The event is sold out.

angles.name: Live from Dorset
angles.copy: The vibes are high at We Out Here Festival in Dorset! Gilles Peterson's incredible lineup is bringing the heat all weekend.

angles.name: Sold Out Success
angles.copy: We Out Here Festival is a sell-out success! Who's there soaking up the jazz, soul, hip hop, and electronic sounds?

moments.title: Green Man Festival Begins
moments.blurb: Wales' largest independent music and arts festival, Green Man, kicks off today in the Brecon Beacons and runs until August 23rd.

angles.name: Brecon Beacons Calling
angles.copy: Green Man Festival is officially open! The Brecon Beacons are alive with music, arts, and incredible vibes this weekend.

angles.name: Welsh Festival Fun
angles.copy: From music to comedy, science to literature, Green Man Festival brings it all to Wales. What's on your must-see list?

moments.title: Beautiful Days Festival
moments.blurb: The family-friendly Beautiful Days Festival starts tomorrow, August 21st, at Escot Park in Devon, running until August 23rd.

angles.name: Devon Festival Ready
angles.copy: Beautiful Days Festival kicks off tomorrow in Devon! Get ready for a weekend of music, good times, and family fun at Escot Park.

angles.name: Westcountry Vibes
angles.copy: The Westcountry's own Beautiful Days Festival is almost here! Who's heading to Escot Park for the annual celebration?

moments.title: Official Singles Chart Update
moments.blurb: The latest UK Official Singles Chart (dated August 13-19) sees Sam Fender & Olivia Dean holding strong at Number 1 with 'Rein Me In', while Madonna & Kylie Minogue enter the chart with 'Love Sensation'.

angles.name: Chart Toppers
angles.copy: Sam Fender & Olivia Dean are still owning the top spot on the Official Singles Chart! 'Rein Me In' is proving unstoppable.

angles.name: Pop Royalty Collab
angles.copy: Madonna and Kylie Minogue together on one track? 'Love Sensation' is a brand new entry on the chart – pure pop royalty!

moments.title: Love Is Blind: UK Season 3
moments.blurb: The third season of the reality dating series 'Love Is Blind: UK' premiered on Netflix on Wednesday, August 19th, with a new group of singles entering the pods.

angles.name: New Season Drop
angles.copy: Love Is Blind: UK is back! Season 3 just dropped on Netflix. Who's already binging the new episodes and forming opinions?

angles.name: Pod Life
angles.copy: More singles, more pods, more drama! Are you ready to see who falls in love sight unseen in the new Love Is Blind: UK?

moments.title: August Bank Holiday Approaching
moments.blurb: The Summer Bank Holiday for England, Wales, and Northern Ireland is on Monday, August 31st, marking the last long weekend of summer.

angles.name: Long Weekend Countdown
angles.copy: The last long weekend of summer is just around the corner! Who's making plans for the August Bank Holiday on Monday 31st?

angles.name: Summer's Last Hurrah
angles.copy: Make the most of it! The August Bank Holiday is traditionally the final chance for a summer getaway before autumn truly sets in.

moments.title: School Summer Holidays Ending
moments.blurb: School summer holidays across the UK are drawing to a close, with most students returning to school in late August or early September.

angles.name: Back To School Prep
angles.copy: The summer holidays are almost over! Parents, are you ready for the back-to-school rush? What are your last-minute survival tips?

angles.name: End of Summer Freedom
angles.copy: Enjoying the last few days of summer freedom before the school bells ring again! What was the highlight of your summer break?

moments.title: Liam Howlett (The Prodigy) turns 55
moments.blurb: Liam Howlett, co-founder and mastermind of electronic music pioneers The Prodigy, celebrates his 55th birthday tomorrow, August 21st.

angles.name: Prodigy Pioneer
angles.copy: Tomorrow, we celebrate Liam Howlett of The Prodigy turning 55! Still bringing the fire after all these years. What's your favourite Prodigy track?

angles.name: Electronic Icon
angles.copy: Happy almost-birthday to Liam Howlett! The man behind some of the most iconic electronic tracks ever. Get ready to 'Firestarter' tomorrow!

moments.title: Kelis turns 46
moments.blurb: Grammy-nominated R&B and soul singer Kelis Rogers, known for hits like 'Milkshake' and 'Caught Out There', celebrates her 46th birthday tomorrow, August 21st.

angles.name: R&B Queen
angles.copy: Tomorrow, the one and only Kelis turns 46! Get ready to play 'Milkshake' on repeat to celebrate the R&B queen's birthday.

angles.name: Caught Out There
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy birthday for tomorrow to Kelis! Her powerful vocals and unique style have given us so many anthems.

moments.title: Shania Twain turns 61
moments.blurb: Country-pop superstar Shania Twain, one of the best-selling music artists of all time, will celebrate her 61st birthday on Thursday, August 28th.

angles.name: Queen of Country Pop
angles.copy: You know you're gonna want to sing along! Shania Twain turns 61 next Thursday. What's your ultimate Shania anthem?

angles.name: Still the One
angles.copy: Next week, let's celebrate the iconic Shania Twain's birthday! Her music still sounds so good, 'That Don't Impress Me Much' – but her career certainly does!

moments.title: Florence Welch turns 40
moments.blurb: Florence Welch, the enigmatic lead singer of Florence + The Machine, will celebrate her 40th birthday on Thursday, August 28th.

angles.name: Happy 40th Florence!
angles.copy: Next Thursday, the incredible Florence Welch turns 40! Get ready to belt out some Florence + The Machine classics to celebrate.

angles.name: Musical Force
angles.copy: From 'Dog Days Are Over' to 'Shake It Out', Florence Welch has given us so many powerful songs. Happy early 40th birthday to a true musical force!

moments.title: LeAnn Rimes turns 44
moments.blurb: Grammy-winning country and pop singer LeAnn Rimes, who rose to fame as a child star, celebrates her 44th birthday on Thursday, August 28th.

angles.name: Country Crossover Star
angles.copy: How do I live without her? LeAnn Rimes turns 44 next Thursday! Celebrate her birthday with all her classic country-pop hits.

angles.name: Child Star Success
angles.copy: From 'Blue' to 'Can't Fight the Moonlight', LeAnn Rimes has had an incredible career. Happy early birthday to the talented singer!
